0: AN ORDINANCE REQUIRING THE VACCINATION OF DOGS AND PROHIBITING TREUTLEN COUNTY RESIDENTS FROM ALLOWING THEIR DOGS TO GO UNRESTRAINED FROM SAID OWNER’S PROPERTY AND PROVIDING FOR PENALTIES FOR THE VIOLATION OF THE SAME.
2: This Ordinance shall be known as and may be cited as the “Treutlen County Dog Ordinance.”
3:
Whereas, consistent with Georgia Law, the Treutlen County Board of Commissioners has the authority to establish by ordinance or resolution such local rules and regulations, not in conflict with existing State or Federal Law, relating to the health, safety, and welfare of the public,

Now therefore be it resolved that the following rule Ordinance is hereby adopted. This Ordinance shall apply to all unincorporated land located within the boundaries of Treutlen County, Georgia.
5:
Animal under Restraint ~ Means any animal within the proper control of its owner as defined. here: (a) Animal is controlled within the property limits of its owner; (b) Animal is controlled by a leash; (c) Animal is at heel or beside a competent person and is obedient to the person’s commands; (d) Animal is within a vehicle being driven or parked on the street.

109

Owner - Means any person or any legal entity including but not limited to a corporation partnership, firm or trust owning, possessing, harboring, keeping, or having custody or control of an animal within Treutlen County, Georgia.

Proper Enclosure - Means an enclosure for keeping an animal while on the owner's property securely confined within the owner's property limits or in a securely enclosed and locked pin, fence, or structure suitable to prevent the entry of young children and designed to prevent the animal from escaping.

Any such structure shall be made secure. If the animal is enclosed within a fence, all sides of the fence shall be of sufficient height and the bottom of the fence shall be constructed in such a manner as to prevent the animal’s escape either from over or from under the fence. Any such enclosure shall also provide protection from the elements for the animal.
7: It shall be unlawful for any owner to keep any dog over the age of fiftytwo (52) weeks in the County without having first obtained a vaccination (inoculation) from a licensed veterinarian. The vaccination (inoculation) shall be identified thereafter on a tag provided by the veterinarian, which must be securely fastened to a collar or harness on the dog. This vaccination tag with the vaccination (inoculation) number on it must be worn at all times by the dog that received the yearly vaccination (inoculation).
8: It shall be unlawful for any owner of a dog to allow such dog in any area in the County without a collar, which shall have attached a valid and current vaccination (inoculation) tag as required by the laws of the state. It shall be the duty of each dog owner to provide a collar with a vaccination (inoculation) tag for each dog; except when such a dog is under immediate of control of the owner, while hunting, or is participating in a dog show or exhibition.
9:
It shall be unlawful for the owner of any dog to permit, or anyone having a dog in his or her possession and control, to permit such dog to be out of control and unattached off the premises of the owner in Treutlen County. It shall be unlawful for the owner of any dog to permit said animal upon the property of

another person without permission of the owner of person in possession thereof. This requirement shall not apply to the following:

- (a) an “animal under restraint” as defined by this Ordinance; and

- (b) an animal while “hunting” on private land.
10: Any and ali dogs found running at large are in violation of this Ordinance. In the event that the owner or one in possession of a dog is not known, surveillance videos or still pictures of the animal(s) playing with children in a homeowner's yard or animals tepeatedly on a homeowner's property, or in near the yards of a county property owner's residence, shall be considered as evidence of ownership of an animal. It shall be unlawful for such owner of any dog(s), to allow such animal to run at large within the County. Once the owner of said animal(s) is found, a fine(s) and/or other punishment will be imposed for each occurrence.
11: It shall be the duty of any owner to keep their dog(s) under restraint and control of said dog at all times while the animal is off the real property of the owner. In the case of dog(s) off the real property of the owner and on the property of another, the animal’s owner must have the property owner's permission for said animal to be there, and under restraint at all times.
12:
It shall be the duty of every owner of a dog to ensure that the animal(s) be kept under restraint, and that precaution are taken to prevent the animal(s) from leaving, while unattended, the real property limits of its owner.

It shall further be the duty of every owner of a dog to ensure that the animal(s) be securely and humanely enclosed within a house, building, fenced area, pen, or other enclosure out of which the animal can not climb, dig out, jump or otherwise escape on its own violation. Such enclosure must be securely locked at any time the animal is unattended. When outside the enclosure but on the owner's property, it shall be the duty of every owner of a dog to ensure that the animal is on a leash and under the control of a competent person.

The use of an electric fence (either above or below ground) is not an acceptable fence.

13: It shall be unlawful for anyone to knowingly dump, abandon, or to aid in the abandonment of any dog on any property located in Treutlen County.
15: Any person who shall do anything prohibited by this Ordinance, as the same exists or as it may hereafter be amended, or who shall fail to do anything required by this Ordinance as the same exists or as it may hereafter be amended, shall be subject to both a fine(s) and/or other punishment, as provided by Treutlen County Code Enforcement Officer and/or the Treutlen County Sheriff or any deputy of the same for violation of this Ordinance. Each day such violation is committed or permitted to continue, shall constitute a separate offense, and shall be punished as such hereunder.
16:
Any owner violating any provision or portion of this Ordinance shall be punished by a fine(s) of not less than $100.00 and not more than $1,000.00, and imprisonment of not more than One (1) year, as a result of the owner’s violation, and/or other punishment, for each occurrence, within the sound discretion of the State Court of Treutlen County, Georgia. The Court may further impose restitution for the repayment of any damages and/or medical expense incurred by any victim, which shall not be considered a part of any fine. The offender(s) may also be directed to perform public serviced as deemed appropriate by the court.

Severability Clause: If any part or portion of this Ordinance shall be ruled invalid, unconstitutional, or otherwise unlawful, the remaining body of the ordinance shall remain in full force and effect.

Repealer Clause: This Ordinance effectively and immediately replaces and otherwise repeals any prior conflicting Ordinances and prior policies of the Treutlen County Board of Commissioners.

Effective Date: This Ordinance shall become effective upon passage by the Treutlen County Board of Commissioners and following notice of the passage of the same by publication for four weeks in the Soperton News, the legal organ of Treutlen County, Georgia.
